entities.summary: The College of Nosa Señora da Antiga is located in Monforte de Lemos, in the province of Lugo, Spain, within the Ribeira Sacra region. Constructed in the Herreriano style, the college is often referred to as the "El Escorial of Galicia" because of its architectural style.
